market: Global EVA Hot Melt Adhesives Market
market_definition: The EVA hot melt adhesives market comprises thermoplastic adhesives based on ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymers that are applied molten and set on cooling. It measures sales of finished formulations for packaging, bookbinding, woodworking and assembly. BY VINYL ACETATE CONTENT: Low VA Content, Medium VA Content, High VA Content. BY APPLICATION METHOD: Roll Coating, Slot / Nozzle Spray, Gun Application. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Food & Beverage Packaging, Corrugated & Carton Converting, Labels & Graphic Films, Tissue, Hygiene & Nonwovens, Bookbinding & Paper Products, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Polyolefin, polyamide, polyester and SBC hot melts; reactive PUR hot melts; hot melt glue sticks; pressure-sensitive hot melts. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
